notes: MPL-2.0 is allowed only for unmodified dependencies (acadrust, colored); modifying one creates a file-level source-publication obligation.
The deny list is a guard, not legal advice. G1 remains open; G2 records the current personal, non-commercial root license in docs/roadmap.md and LICENSE.
LGPL matches the GPL substring on purpose: a statically linked LGPL kernel cannot be shipped closed-source without relink rights.

LicenseRef-AtlasCAD-Personal-NonCommercial applies only to first-party root workspace crates. Do not treat it as permission to use the AtlasCAD platform commercially or as a license for imported components.
Fingerprints cover each declared path; root-level files such as Cargo.toml and docs/ are curated evidence, not scanned inputs.
Symlinks are never followed, so a scan cannot escape the workspace or loop.
The workspace is tracked by the root Git repository; source origins and imported revisions are recorded in docs/integration/source-snapshot.md.
